packets.title: Structured AI output validation and parser
packets.deliverable: Validate zero/one/many proposed actions and uncertainty against frozen schema.
packets.acceptance: Malformed model output fails closed; fields/provenance stable and no fabricated identities/dates.

packets.deliverable: Feed immutable discussion version through AI adapter and create source-grounded candidate Tasks.
packets.acceptance: No-action, multi-action, ambiguous text tests; message/version linkage and actual event contract pass.

packets.title: Human review to authoritative Task integration
packets.deliverable: Preserve authorised confirm/edit/reject and idempotent Task creation for new proposal output.
packets.acceptance: Real service connector, duplicate protection, negative authorisation and Audit provenance pass.

packets.title: Freeze and pass AI extraction benchmark
packets.deliverable: Evaluate against predetermined 30-case fixture without tuning test labels after results.
packets.acceptance: 30-case frozen fixture passes required precision/recall; cost and provider usage are recorded, budget exhaustion falls back safely and no extra unapproved model is selected.

packets.title: On-demand source-grounded discussion summary
packets.deliverable: Provide bounded summary with source references and no source disclosure across projects.
packets.acceptance: Test empty, multi-message, unauthorised, model failure and source-grounding behaviours.

packets.title: Hosted AI action end-to-end smoke
packets.deliverable: Demonstrate browser Discussion->model->proposal->approval->Task->Audit on hosted target.
packets.acceptance: Hosted real OpenAI Luna Medium requests generate reviewed tasks, correct sources and idempotent authoritative actions; monthly organisation cap and budget exhaustion are verified.

packets.title: Atomic authorised project-creation API
packets.deliverable: Create minimal project and required health/responsibility in one authorised flow.
packets.acceptance: Transactional creation, idempotency, RBAC and same-person initial roles where policy permits.

packets.title: Minimal project-creation browser UI
packets.deliverable: Permit an authenticated individual to create a project without a developer.
packets.acceptance: Browser create and reopen; no hard-coded starter project; empty/error states tested. Uses approved Cadence V1 visual and interaction standard; avoids one-off styling or inaccessible controls.

packets.title: Authorised project-list API
packets.deliverable: List only projects accessible to effective Person membership.
packets.acceptance: Two-project, different roles, outsider not-visible and stable paginated DTO tests.

packets.title: Project selection and scoped navigation
packets.deliverable: Replace configured fixed project ID with authorised user selection.
packets.acceptance: Project switch, refresh/relogin and unauthorised project denial tested; stable project identity. Uses approved Cadence V1 visual and interaction standard; avoids one-off styling or inaccessible controls.

packets.title: Self-service internal membership API
packets.deliverable: Provide self-service invitation/admission and project membership for approved SSO identities without local Cadence passwords.
packets.acceptance: An eligible Azure/Google identity can be admitted to the right Person and project; external/unapproved users denied; disabled and removed users fail closed; no ad hoc SQL or local password required.

packets.title: Membership onboarding browser workflow
packets.deliverable: Let authorised manager invite/admit members through normal UI.
packets.acceptance: Approved organisation member can be invited and admitted by authorised UI; a forbidden identity is denied; SSO sign-in, permission changes, and revocation are shown with useful states.

packets.title: Protected role UI and same-person scenario
packets.deliverable: Allow valid initial overlapping responsibilities, manage protected role moves safely.
packets.acceptance: Permission and succession history tests; no automatic role assumption from organisational title. Uses approved Cadence V1 visual and interaction standard; avoids one-off styling or inaccessible controls.

packets.title: Task update/status API with permissions
packets.deliverable: Task update/status/assignment API with permissions; retain the existing authoritative manual Task create path.
packets.acceptance: Open/in-progress/completed/cancelled transitions, auth, optimistic concurrency/history pass.

packets.title: Task lifecycle browser UI
packets.deliverable: Usable Task lifecycle browser UI including manual Create Task, assignment, priority, status update and completion without an AI service.
packets.acceptance: Any authorised user can manually create, edit and finish a Task while OpenAI is unavailable or the USD 5 quota is exhausted; My Tasks and Audit reflect every change.

packets.title: Synchronise My Tasks and Audit after changes
packets.deliverable: Ensure human and agent Task updates remain accurately visible and auditable.
packets.acceptance: Fresh My Tasks, cross-project isolation, created/updated/completed history and no duplicate events.

packets.title: Workspace read model for current work
packets.deliverable: Provide pending/overdue work and project condition through one consistent API.
packets.acceptance: Current tasks and role-specific project view from real persistence, not fixtures.

packets.title: Company workspace UI with Decisions entry
packets.deliverable: Show projects, responsibilities, Decisions and concise project state in coherent navigation.
packets.acceptance: Switch between two projects and access Decision Register, with correct empty/error states. Uses approved Cadence V1 visual and interaction standard; avoids one-off styling or inaccessible controls.

packets.title: Decision provenance, metadata and RLS (no raw transcripts)
packets.deliverable: Persist minimal Decision-source provenance and approved extracted evidence while prohibiting retention of the full imported transcript.
packets.acceptance: Decision source metadata, extraction time, source fingerprint and approved minimal evidence retained with RBAC/RLS; full imported transcript is not stored in the business database, storage, logs or backups.

packets.title: Decision proposal, approval and Audit persistence
packets.deliverable: Implement canonical proposed/confirmed/rejected decision flow and source references.
packets.acceptance: Approved decision only after authorised human; idempotent approve, evidence/rationale, immutable audit.

packets.title: Decision API/service and source navigation
packets.deliverable: Expose authorised source, proposed Decision, approval and Decision Register queries.

packets.title: Manual Decision register/review browser UI
packets.deliverable: Create/view/review Decision manually with evidence and approver.

packets.title: Normalised pasted-text Decision intake
packets.deliverable: Enter, edit/confirm and save text source consistently across input methods.

packets.title: Text transcript import parser
packets.deliverable: Parse .txt/.md/.vtt/.srt imported transcripts through the same transient normalisation interface, without persistent document upload.

packets.title: Grounded AI Decision extraction
packets.deliverable: Extract zero/one/many agreed Decisions from bounded source text; do not treat suggestions as decisions.

packets.title: End-to-end transcript/text Decision approval
packets.deliverable: Join text/import->AI proposals->authorised review->Decision Register->source.
packets.acceptance: 5-project-compatible flow covers paste and supported transcript file, AI candidate, human edit/reject/confirm, register/provenance; verify no retained raw transcript in DB, files, logs and backup.

packets.title: Audio fast feasibility, consent/privacy gate
packets.deliverable: Time-box audio only if provider, consent, file limits and remaining delivery capacity are proven.
packets.acceptance: GO or DEFERRED_BY_CAP; no new feature scope or date change; prerequisites verified.

packets.title: Browser Start/Stop/preview capture
packets.deliverable: Capture short audio within explicit size/duration limits, only with consent.
packets.acceptance: Start/stop/preview/discard, permission denied and browser unsupported tests.

packets.title: Server transcription adapter and disposal
packets.deliverable: Transcribe bounded server-uploaded audio, discard raw media and return editable text.
packets.acceptance: Credentials server-side, file validation, retention/consent, failures and disposal tests.

packets.title: Audio-to-standard Decision pipeline smoke
packets.deliverable: Pass the transcript to the same text-source service with no new Decision engine.
packets.acceptance: Record->transcribe->edit->propose->review works; otherwise audio remains off with recorded deferral.

packets.title: Continuous consumer-provider contract CI

packets.title: Independent isolated database restore proof

packets.acceptance: One sponsor visual direction sign-off from actual Codex-produced screenshots or sketches; versioned token names; mobile/navigation/accessibility checklist; no copied code/brand assets and no scope expansion.

packets.title: Implement refined login and responsive workspace shell
packets.deliverable: Apply approved styling to login, topbar, navigation, summary panels, typography, spacing, forms and core feedback states. Preserve React and existing business contracts.
packets.acceptance: Responsive, visually cohesive login and workspace with SSO-only sign-in, project navigation, desktop/mobile accessibility, meaningful error/empty states and no fake release identity.

packets.title: Confirm V1 visual consistency and usability

packets.title: Configurable Entra ID and Google OAuth sign-in

packets.acceptance: Both provider adapters/configs and redirect allowlists verified with mocked flow; HELP Entra live login evidenced with approved tenant and identity-provider credentials; no local Cadence password and no unknown-account automatic access.

packets.title: SSO Person mapping, tenant restriction and revocation
packets.deliverable: Map approved OAuth subjects to stable Cadence Person/memberships; enforce organisation/tenant allowlist and denial/revocation without altering Person history.
packets.acceptance: Valid tenant identity admitted only when authorised; matching emails alone never grant project authority; disabled membership/identity denied immediately; switching allowed providers does not change canonical Person or owner/sponsor/manager history.

packets.title: Configurable monthly organisation AI cap

packets.title: Transient transcript intake and deletion
packets.deliverable: Process text/transcript in bounded temporary memory, extract structured candidates, discard full raw text promptly, retain approved derived Decision evidence only.
packets.acceptance: Success, rejection, timeout and failure paths remove raw source; raw is absent from persistence, logs, files, crash outputs and backups; provider requests request non-storage where supported; help/privacy notice differentiates app deletion from external provider retention.

packets.title: Configurable primary and backup operator roles
packets.deliverable: Allow authorised assignment/replacement of named primary and backup operators and contact routes without application code changes; preserve least privilege.
packets.acceptance: Operator can be replaced by approved administrative action/config, auditable Person identity, no hard-coded email or personal laptop path, no global project-reader access, operator support handover proven.

packets.title: Bounded overnight Codex runner on Windows laptop
packets.deliverable: Run eligible approved work packets continuously on powered, networked laptop, preserving fixed packet scope, remote checkpoints and safe stop/resume.
packets.acceptance: Runner auto-selects only eligible contract packets; verifies repo/account/worktree and lease; applies time/attempt/credential/CI/merge gates; restarts safely after simulated interruption; emits end-of-run status and blocks privileged actions, hosted deployments and new scopes until approvals.
